evidence.quote: precomputes and stores embeddings from various Biological Foundation Models
Each embedding type receives its own modality-specific Q-former
These query vectors interact with the input embeddings through cross-attention
The master Q-former model is a 6-layer InstructBLIP-style [19] Q-Former that fuses the Stage 1 modality-specific tokens with a natural-language instruction
the query tokens cross-attend with both the instruction tokens and self-attend with each other
and cross-attend to the layer-normalised Stage 1 visual tokens every two transformer layers
producing a fixed-length multimodal prefix for the LLM. Finally
produces 32 refined query tokens for the LLM
with the LLM's weights frozen, so the loss only updates the projection weights
Notably, the LLM is not trained or fine-tuned during any point in the training regime.
